metadata.description: Static HTML examples for the OpenPlayerJS media player library. Served via `serve .` from the repo root.
metadata.notes: No authentication. No SPA router. Each page is a standalone HTML file demonstrating a player feature. The `serve` static server strips .html from URLs (301 redirect). Sub-states model meaningful in-page UI changes within the shared OpenPlayerJS player shell.

layouts.label: Standard OpenPlayerJS player shell (createUI + buildControls)
layouts.description: Pages that use createUI() and buildControls() to render the full .op-player wrapper with .op-controls bar. Includes: progress bar on top, play/time/volume on bottom-left, settings/fullscreen (and optionally captions) on bottom-right. Center overlay .op-player__play present.

layouts.label: Bare Core API — native browser video controls only
layouts.description: core.html uses new Core() without createUI(). No .op-player wrapper. Uses native HTML5 <video> controls element.

layouts.label: Player UI + status text indicator (#status div)
layouts.description: source-fallback.html adds a #status <div> below the player that updates with fallback/error information.

layouts.label: Player UI + external source-switch buttons
layouts.description: src-switch.html adds #controls div with 'Switch source' and 'Restore source' buttons outside the player wrapper.

layouts.label: Static server auto-generated directory index
layouts.description: The `serve` package serves the repo root as a file browser at /.
